text:
nina (finance): FYI: shipping a billing policy tweak on 2026-07-01. Small change set to improve invoice clarity and customer friendliness.

rex (revops): Summary: 1) 'Free credits applied' will be its own pre-tax line item. 2) Trials for new signups reduced from 90d->60d (existing trials grandfathered for 30 days). 3) Micro-overages under $15 will be auto-refunded as a credit on the next invoice (once per billing period).

maya (cs): How will we surface this to customers?

nina (finance): Customer email, in-console banner 48h before, changelog entry, and FAQ page. Draft email linked: <https://internal.redwood/comm/billing/jul-2026-draft>.

eli (eng): No API breaking changes. We'll add new fields to webhook payload: `free_credits_applied` and `micro_overage_credit`. Also adding SDK guidance for the soft-burst 429 behavior for free-tier keys:```json
{"status":429,"error":"quota_exceeded","retry_after":30}```

billing-bot: Billing webhook v2 deployed to staging (auto).

rex (revops): Ops note: micro-overage credit will not apply to accounts with active disputes or delinquency. Data export will include `micro_overage_credit` column.

maya (cs): Can we get a short FAQ for CS? Mgmt wants a one-pager.

nina (finance): Uploading FAQ now. Please review and add any region-specific tax notes.

eli (eng): We'll flip the feature flag in staging 2026-06-10 and prod 2026-06-20. Let eng/integrations know if you rely on the old CSV fields.

maya (cs): :thumbsup: will review FAQ and respond by EOD Friday.

rex (revops): If no objections, we'll publish on Monday and send the customer email Wednesday. Quick reactions appreciated.

nina (finance): :white_check_mark:
